scope: Advance the original NTFS scope with a bounded supplied-byte FILE record envelope and update-sequence validation/restoration primitive. No boot geometry, attribute/runlist traversal, native opening, filesystem verdict, source authority, writer or frontend admission follows.
ownership: Private C90 portable/ntfs/ntfs.h and record.c use the existing checked byte/u64 representation. Native probe and independent generated-byte tests own their oracles. No packed native-struct casts, native64 requirement, duplicate arithmetic or speculative source tree.
format: Explicit NTFS major/minor context; selected profile covers3.0/3.1 common FILE headers. Observe exact raw signature, sequence, attribute offset, flags, used/allocated sizes, base reference and next-attribute identifier. Preserve uninterpreted flags/reserved bytes. The common header ends at42 bytes; variable USA may begin at42 or48 and must precede attributes. No record-number-extension interpretation.
fixups: Use512-byte sequence strides independently of physical-sector geometry. The on-disk USA count is a count of16-bit entries: record_bytes/512+1. Require aligned array offset at least42, complete exact array ending at or before byte510, and every protected tail equal to the first USA word before any restoration. Preserve mismatched-tail count and original bytes; do not partially repair a torn record.
source_discrepancy: Microsoft MULTI_SECTOR_HEADER's member description calls array size bytes, while its detailed size formula uses ushort entries. The primary Linux implementation/layout independently confirm a word count. This contract explicitly selects the on-disk entry-count interpretation and records the discrepancy rather than copying the inconsistent prose.
api: Observe returns DE_OK plus issue bits for a bounded malformed record, retaining raw values when available. Invalid API arguments and oversized budget return the existing checked status with observation unchanged. Restoration revalidates the supplied original record, requires a complete consistent FILE envelope for the selected version and sufficient separate output storage, validates all tails before copying, then restores only tail words in caller-owned RAM. Reject exact/partial source/output overlap using portable pointer equality over bounded spans; preserve input, output and result on restoration failure.
relationships: Require a complete512-multiple record within the selected budget, exact allocated-size equality, used<=allocated, aligned first-attribute offset after the USA, and room for an attribute end marker. A valid envelope/fixup is not valid attributes, a complete filesystem, an atomic read, current identity or authority. Unknown flag bits remain raw observations, not extra permissions.
acceptance: Independent Python byte/struct oracles across512/1024/4096/49152-byte records, both header layouts, every stride tail, boundary USA placements, raw64 values and uninterpreted bytes/flags.

Truncated records/header/array, odd/overlapping/out-of-first-stride offsets, missing/extra USA entries, bad signature/version/header relationships and one/many mismatched tails retain exact diagnostics without reading outside input.

Successful restoration matches independent bytes; invalid record/version/budget/capacity and source/output overlap leave all destination/result sentinels unchanged. Guard/read-only input and bounded generated mutations exercise the actual C90 implementation.

Actual selected compiler/build/launch/header/import/context/tooling and artifact identities. Original failures stay retained; no owner, legacy-host, NTFS volume/provider or full0.1.0 qualification is manufactured.
source_use: Functional format references only; independently authored implementation/tests. No upstream code imported or executed.
later_gates: Boot/MFT addressing, attributes, runlists, names/security/compression/encryption and complete volume observations.
Held source, contained reader, common frontend and all original platform/storage operations.
